turns.text: Okay, here comes the next mistake.
Have you ever seen old buildings in the city where you live?
turns.zh: 你见过你住的城市里的老建筑吗？

turns.text: Yes, old buildings are a prominent part of the landscape in my hometown.
turns.zh: 是的，老建筑是我家乡景观中很突出的一部分。

turns.text: With the development of technology, they have grown like a spider's web.
turns.zh: 随着技术的发展，它们已经像蜘蛛网一样蔓延开来。

turns.text: Well, I think clearly here the problem is the student has memorized the answer.
turns.zh: 嗯，我觉得这里很明显的问题是学生把答案背下来了。
